fato_historico: 1960: At the Summer Olympics in Rome, Abebe Bikila becomes the first sub-Saharan African to win a gold medal, winning the marathon in bare feet.

You may feel a gentle push to move forward with persistence and grace. Consider embracing your natural pace; it is a good time to trust your instincts and let your innate stability lead the way through any challenges.
frase_do_dia: Strength is found in the steady heartbeat of your own determined spirit.
